current_evidence: The council's live 'Apply for homeowner planning permission' page says 'You can see what supporting information you'll need to apply in our Local List' and links to downloads/download/291/local-list. That download page and Grokbot's file/452 are both blocked by robots.txt, so I could not confirm the file or date the council currently serves, and no newer list turned up in search.

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' field is just the council homepage (https://www.rochdale.gov.uk), not a planning or validation page. The page that links the Local List is https://www.rochdale.gov.uk/planning-permission/apply-homeowner-planning-permission.
issues.evidence: That page: 'You can see what supporting information you'll need to apply in our Local List' -> downloads/download/291/local-list

issues.detail: The list is flagged 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' (October 2022). The council has not published a newer local list that I could find, but this could not be confirmed because the download page is blocked.

None of the 17 tab_items is a local requirement. They are drawing and e-submission formatting rules ('A3 paper size where possible', 'No individual file to be greater than 10MB', 'No .zip, .exe, .doc or .docx files', 'CAD files will not be accepted'), split sentence fragments ('If this is the case, you may be able to provide information in hard copy or electronically (e.g.' / 'CD, USB storage device, online file transfer).'), the invalid-application 14-day retention note, and glossary definitions of 'Habitats Site' and 'Special Protection Areas'. Judged from Grokbot's extracted text, since the source could not be fetched.
issues.evidence: tab_items sections 'Drawing / document standards', 'Submission rules', 'Policy-driven requirements'

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is placed under Works to trees. Its excerpt is the end of a demolition checklist ('Bat and Bird Surveys, Demolition Method Statement') followed by the heading of Appendix 7, the Works to Trees checklist. It is not a listed building schedule of works and does not belong to tree applications. 'Lighting Assessment' under Listed building consent is also only the last line of one appendix running into the Appendix 5 LBC checklist header.
issues.evidence: trigger_excerpt: 'Bat and Bird Surveys Demolition Method Statement ... Appendix 7 - Application for Works to Trees in a Conservation Area or subject of a Tree Preservation Order Indicative Checklist'

issues.detail: Grokbot's own excerpts show the document has per-application-type 'Indicative Checklist' appendices: at least Appendix 5 (Listed Building Consent) and Appendix 7 (Works to Trees), with tick-box local information requirements such as Bat and Bird Surveys and Demolition Method Statement. Even so, Grokbot recorded '(none)' for Householder, Outline, Reserved matters, Advertisement, Lawful development cert, Demolition in cons area, s73 and others. The main local list table (requirement / policy driver / when required, e.g. viability where obligations are sought under CS Policy DM2, amenity constraints under G9/DM1, trees under BS 5837 / G6) has also been captured only as garbled fragments. Contents could not be verified line by line because the source is blocked.
issues.evidence: trigger_excerpt: 'Appendix 5 - Listed Building Consent Application Indicative Checklist National Information Requirements ... Local Information Requirements - these may be required for your scheme'

issues.detail: The trigger excerpts are garbled table text or glossary definitions, not triggers. Arboricultural Impact Assessment: the excerpt is a run-on mix of BS 5837/G6 and the viability/planning obligations row (DM2). Planning Obligations: the excerpt runs into an amenity-constraints row. Transport Statement and Travel Plan: glossary definitions ('A simplified version of a transport assessment...', 'A long-term management strategy...') with no thresholds. Photographs: the PDF-format submission rule. Highways/visibility splays: location plan red-line guidance. Pre-application advice: the fragment 'you during pre-application discussions.' Environmental Statement: a checklist heading.

All 11 Full planning rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', even though the source arranges local requirements in per-application-type indicative checklists. Examples: Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Ecological Survey, Structural Survey and Transport Assessment. Fire Statement and Design and Access Statement are national requirements, not local ones.
issues.evidence: notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list'

summary: I could not verify against the source: Rochdale's /downloads/ path (both Grokbot's file/452 and the council's live Local List download page) blocks fetching, so the October 2022 date and currency are unconfirmed. Judged from Grokbot's own extracted text, the capture is very poor: every tab_item is formatting or glossary text, the excerpts show per-application-type checklists (Appendices 5 and 7 and others) that Grokbot ignored while recording '(none)' for most types, and the triggers are garbled.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The source could not be verified. Grokbot's file URL and the council's Local List download page (downloads/download/291/local-list) both return robots_disallowed. The date 'Published October 2022', the currency of the list and its contents all need a manual check in a browser. The only other official copy found online is the July 2020 consultation draft on consultations.rochdale.gov.uk (consultation closed 14 Sept 2020). planning.data.gov.uk points at that draft, not at an adopted list.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: WebFetch: 'failed at its site (robots_disallowed)'; planning.data.gov.uk entity 20300 document-url = 'Local List Final Draft for Public Consultation.pdf'
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: This is an auditor access limitation, not a workbook error. The adopted list is captured in raw (f528cb52a8) and reads "Published October 2022", so the workbook's date and source are verifiable and correct.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. This was a note about what my helpers could not read, not a Grokbot error, so it is removed from the issue counts. The council stays on "Still to check by hand".
